item.text:
Added `resolver.ClientConn.ReportError(error)` and `resolver.State.Err`, forwarding resolver failures to balancers. Fail-fast RPCs now return an `Unavailable` error containing the resolver error, and waiting picks are woken when an error is reported. The built-in pick-first and base balancers also enter transient failure.

`git diff --check` passed. `go build ./...` could not run because the sandbox could not resolve `proxy.golang.org`; I did not run tests.
